question.problem: If ${e}^{2x+3}=7,$ then $x≈${{field-1}}, rounded to $3$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
First, we take $ln$ of both sides of the equation and solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{e}^{2x+3} & =7 \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡({e}^{2x+3}) & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(7) \\ 2x+3 & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(7) \\ 2x & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(7)-3 \\ x & =\frac{\operatorname{ln}⁡(7)-3}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating the above expression using a calculator gives

$$
x≈-0.527
$$

rounded to $3$ decimal places.
